free_tier.stated: Free: USD 0 with a one-time 14-day Pro trial of 300 Credits, limited completions and next edits, and BYOK; when Credits run out, basic models subject to daily and monthly limits whose numbers are not published. Promotions open to Free accounts: 100 Credits claimable once a day in the Qoder desktop app, each claim valid 30 days, end time to be announced; Qwen3.8-Flash at a 0.0x Credit rate, end date to be announced; a daily free allowance of DeepSeek-Flash until 2026-10-31 24:00 UTC+8
free_tier.notes: Credits are deducted by model and by input plus output tokens, not by a flat request count; request-count is the nearest metered_on term. Estimated consumption: about 50 Credits per Qoder Agent Mode request, about 7 to 12 per Editor Agent Mode request, about 3 to 4 per Editor Ask request, so 100 Credits a day is about 2 Qoder Agent Mode requests or about 8 Editor Agent Mode requests at a 200K context. Paid ladder: Lite USD 10 a month with 1,000 Credits for curated models, Pro USD 20 with 2,000, Pro+ USD 60 with 6,000, Ultra USD 200 with 20,000; a Credit Pack is USD 20 for 1,500 Credits on paid plans.

interface_detail: the Qoder desktop app, Qoder IDE, the JetBrains plugin and Qoder CLI share one Credits balance. Qoder CLI runs headless with `qoder -p` (long form `--print`), prints text, json or stream-json, takes the prompt from an argument or standard input, and authenticates without a browser through the QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable
tooling: Qoder CLI, installed with `curl -fsSL https://qoder.com/install | bash` on macOS and Linux or `irm https://qoder.com/install.ps1 | iex` on Windows, or from npm as @qoder-ai/qodercli; the Qoder desktop app and IDE
chaining: the Free plan includes BYOK, so the CLI and IDE can run on a key from another inference provider once the daily Credits and the free Qwen3.8-Flash route are spent; a USD 10 Lite subscription adds the Efficient tier at 0.0x while that offer lasts

limits.value: 100 Credits a day, claimed by hand once per daily window in the Qoder desktop app, each claim valid 30 days; about 2 Qoder Agent Mode requests at about 50 Credits each
after Credits run out, free basic models subject to daily and monthly limits; no number is published
a one-time 14-day Pro trial with 300 Credits, one account per user, granted on first sign-in to the latest Qoder desktop app and not available on virtual machines
Lite at USD 10 a month: 1,000 Credits a month for curated models; paid users select the Efficient tier at 0.0x for a limited time, rate-limited or slower at peak hours

binding_note: the free allowance is a count of Credits and model uses per day; the daily 100-Credit claim, about 2 agent requests, runs out before any other limit, and the unpublished basic-model limit is what remains after it

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up form asks for a first name, a last name, an email address and a password, or Google or GitHub sign-up; no card is named for the Free plan; the Pro trial is one per user and extra trial accounts are suspended; the terms set a minimum age of 18; paid plans accept Visa, Mastercard, Alipay, Google Pay and Apple Pay

reliability_note: Qwen3.8-Flash and the Efficient tier are documented as slower or rate-limited at peak hours during their free offers; the Lite model tier was removed on 2026-09-18 and headless requests that named it fail
confidence_note: the plan ladder, the trial, the daily Credit claim, the free-model promotions, the headless flags and the sign-up fields are quoted from first-party pages read. The size of the basic-model daily and monthly limit is not published anywhere read, so it stays unverified; no account was opened.
